column2: For weapons that have a damage-over-time effect that applies on each shot, the calculation is simply the sum of the damage over time effect plus any other damage (such as from the round) divide over the total time. / To visualize this, imagine the timeline for Alethonym. You have the moment of time between firing the weapon and the time to finish reload right after. / The DoT effect overlaps past the end of the moment and wraps back past the beginning of the moment. / The result is that the entire DoT effect is contained in the time to reload.
